bound.loss_definition: L=sum squared standardized raw measurement residuals; scipy_cost=L/2

bound.scope: Optimization level set only; no statistical coverage, parameter-truth or global-convergence claim.
bound.interpretation: Scalar cap preserves all candidate points with L<=incumbent L under the stated passivity conditions; it is not an externally calibrated impedance range.
